name: Gachancipá (Colombia)
description: Green field with an arrowhead of white and yellow pointing from the hoist to the fly.
history: Municipal flag of Gachancipá, a municipality in the department of Cundinamarca, Colombia; Colombian municipal flags are adopted by agreement (acuerdo) of the municipal council or by decree of the mayor.

features.role: arrowhead of white over yellow pointing to the fly
